effectSummary.ko: 도발의 낙인이 남은 적에게 갈고리를 직접 맞히면 낙인을 2초 연장하고 자원 8을 추가 회복합니다. 최초 표식 시점에서 총 8초를 넘기지 않으며 재발동 간격은 4초입니다.
effectSummary.en: Directly hooking your branded target extends the brand by 2s and restores 8 extra resource. Never extend beyond 8s from initial application; 4s interval.

description.ko: 8m 안의 적 하나에게 6초간 전사 표식을 남기고 자원 10을 회복합니다. 그 적에게 받는 피해가 10% 감소합니다. 표식은 피해 증가를 따로 주지 않으며 전사의 Marked 조건을 충족합니다. 동시에 하나만 유지합니다.
description.en: Brand one enemy within 8m for 6s and restore 10 resource. Take 10% less damage from that enemy. The brand supplies Marked without a separate damage bonus. Only one Warrior brand may exist.

description.ko: 6m 안의 적 하나에게 D65% 물리 피해를 주고 최대 2m 끌어옵니다. 직접 적중하면 자원 10을 회복합니다. 보스에게는 이동 대신 제압 수치를 줍니다.
description.en: Deal D65% physical damage to one enemy within 6m and pull it up to 2m. Restore 10 resource on a direct hit. Bosses receive stagger credit instead of movement.

concept: A short massive chain necklace whose pendant is a recurved iron grappling hook clasped around a compact bronze brand seal with a deep red inset. Asymmetric hook and broad heavy chain express pursuit and extended grip; no floating emblem or text.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LW41, Pursuer's Chain, class Warrior, slot necklace.
Subject design: A short massive chain necklace whose pendant is a recurved iron grappling hook clasped around a compact bronze brand seal with a deep red inset. Asymmetric hook and broad heavy chain express pursuit and extended grip; no floating emblem or text.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: Directly hooking your branded target extends the brand by 2s and restores 8 extra resource. Never extend beyond 8s from initial application; 4s interval.
Direct skill context: W07 Brand of Challenge — Brand one enemy within 8m for 6s and restore 10 resource. Take 10% less damage from that enemy. The brand supplies Marked without a separate damage bonus. Only one Warrior brand may exist.; W08 Impaling Hook — Deal D65% physical damage to one enemy within 6m and pull it up to 2m. Restore 10 resource on a direct hit. Bosses receive stagger credit instead of movement.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: square native PNG with real transparent alpha; the built-in 1254 by 1254 output is accepted, and 1024 by 1024 is also accepted. Preserve native pixels and alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Aim to contain the entire subject, including all tips and chain, within the central 76% with generous transparent padding. No part may be clipped or missing. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
